entries.source: 'BACK SO SOON? I CAN ONLY REPEAT THE EARLIER OFFERS: '
entries.text: 「這麼快就回來了？我能給的還是先前那幾項：」

entries.source: 'BEHIND THESE DOORS ARE THE SPECIAL TRAINING SCHOOLS  WHERE ADVENTURERS INCREASE THEIR SKILLS. LET US NOW GO TO THE CITY'S MOST IMPORTANT BUILDING.'
entries.text: 「這幾道門後面是各種訓練所，冒險者在裡面精進本事。接下來去看看城裡最重要的建築。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第五頁。訓練所沿用說明書 p.9 的用詞。

entries.source: 'BEYOND THIS GATE ARE THE MONSTER-RIDDEN AREAS OF THE OLD CITY WE ARE SLOWLY PREPARING FOR SETTLEMENT.  THE COUNCIL OFFERS A GENEROUS REWARD TO THOSE WHO CLEAR AREAS OF MONSTERS.
entries.text: 「這道門外就是舊城區，那裡滿是怪物，我們正一步步整頓、準備讓人遷入。清掉一區怪物的人，市議會會給一筆優厚的報酬。
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第七頁。原版這一句沒有結尾引號，照原樣不補。

entries.source: 'BY ORDER OF THE CITY COUNCIL,' THE HARBOR MASTER SAYS, 'THE ONLY BOAT OUT IS GOING TO SOKAL KEEP.  YOU CAN CATCH IT AT THE END OF THE PIER.'
entries.text: 港務長說：「市議會有令，現在唯一出港的船是開往索卡爾城堡的。到碼頭盡頭就能搭上。」

entries.source: 'BY THE WAY, YOUR BUNGLING THE BIVANT RESCUE HAS COST US.'
entries.text: 「對了，畢凡特那次救援你們搞砸了，我們付出了代價。」

entries.source: 'CATCH THE BOAT AT THE END OF THE PIER.'
'DUE TO YOUR VICIOUS ATTACK ON THOSE WHO PROTECT US, WE REFUSE YOU ALL SERVICE.'
entries.text: 「你們竟然攻擊保護我們的人，這裡不再為你們提供任何服務。」

entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'GREETINGS, COURAGEOUS ONES, I AM ROLF, APPOINTED BY THE COUNCIL TO INTRODUCE NEWCOMERS TO THE FAIR CITY OF PHLAN. IF YOU WILL ACCOMPANY ME, I WILL START THE TOUR.'
entries.text: 「勇敢的朋友們，你們好。我是羅夫，市議會派我為新來的人介紹美麗的菲蘭城。願意跟我走一趟的話，導覽這就開始。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第一頁。Phlan 依 glossary 定案作菲蘭；Rolf 說明書未收，見 glossary 的「遊戲內文字新增譯名」。

entries.source: 'HE IS BOUND TO RECOVER THE TEMPLE WHICH HAS BEEN DESECRATED TO BANE.  GO WITH HIM ACROSS THE RIVER AND HELP HIM TO CLEANSE THE TEMPLE.  IN PAYMENT, YOU MAY KEEP THE HIDDEN TREASURES.'
entries.text: 「他發願要奪回那座被獻給邪惡神的神殿。跟他過河去，幫他把神殿清乾淨。作為報酬，藏在裡面的財寶歸你們。」
entries.note: 巴西歐主教的委託；Bane 依 glossary 作邪惡（神）。

entries.source: 'I HAVE BEEN AUTHORIZED TO GIVE YOU AN ENCHANTED WEAPON IF YOU ACCEPT THE COMMISSION TO END THE GRAVEYARD MENACE.  DO YOU ACCEPT?'
entries.text: 「只要你們接下解除墳場之患的委託，我獲准贈與一件附魔武器。你們接嗎？」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'IT IS IMPERATIVE THAT A MESSAGE BE DELIVERED TO THE ZHENTIL OUTPOST TO THE WEST.  I AM SENDING YOU AS DIPLOMATIC ENVOYS.
entries.text: 「有一封信務必送到西邊的漢提爾前哨。我要派你們以使節的身分前往。

entries.source: 'IT IS THE UNANIMOUS REQUEST OF THE COUNCIL THAT YOU LEAD THE ATTACK. YOUR SKILL AND BRAVERY HAVE WON THE ADMIRATION OF ALL PHLAN.  WE LOOK TO YOU TO HELP US WIN OUR FREEDOM.'
entries.text: 「議會一致請求由你們領軍。你們的本事與膽識已贏得全菲蘭城的敬佩。我們指望你們幫我們贏回自由。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'IT WILL COST YOU 1 PLATINUM PIECE TO REST HERE.  DO YOU WANT TO STAY?'
entries.text: 「在這裡休息要一枚白金幣。你們要住下嗎？」

entries.source: 'ON YOUR RIGHT IS ONE OF THE ENTRANCE'S TO SUNE'S TEMPLE. AS WITH ALL PHLAN'S TEMPLES, VARIOUS CLERICAL SERVICES ARE OFFERED INSIDE.  ON YOUR LEFT IS AN ENTRANCE TO THE CITY PARK.'
entries.text: 「右手邊是蘇妮神殿的入口之一。和菲蘭城其他神殿一樣，裡面提供各種神職服務。左手邊則是通往市立公園的入口。」

entries.source: 'OUR TOUR IS ENDED. AGAIN, LET ME URGE YOU TO APPLY TO THE CITY CLERK FOR A COMMISSION.  GOOD-BYE AND GOOD FORTUNE.' (YOU ARE ON YOUR OWN NOW)
entries.text: 「導覽到此結束。再提醒一次，記得去找書記官接委託。再會，祝你們好運。」（接下來就靠你們自己了）
entries.note: Rolf 導覽最後一頁。括號內是原版給玩家的旁白，不是羅夫的話。

entries.source: 'THANK YOU FOR COMING.  I MUST BE BRIEF FOR OUR NEED IS URGENT.  OUR ONE CHANCE TO DEFEAT THE ENEMY IS THROUGH AN ASSAULT ON THE CASTLE. TO DO THIS, WE MUST FIRST SECURE STOJANOW GATE.
entries.text: 「多謝你們前來。事情緊急，我就長話短說。要擊敗敵人只有一條路——強攻城堡。而要做到這一點，得先拿下史塔傑諾門。

entries.source: 'THE FAITHFUL SERVANT SENT TO FETCH IT NEVER RETURNED.  THE COMPLEX IS JUST SOUTH OF PODOL PLAZA.  BRING THE TREASURE TO ME AND YOU WILL BE WELL REWARDED.'
entries.text: 「派去取回它的忠僕再也沒有回來。那片建築就在波多廣場南邊。把寶物帶回來給我，必有重賞。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: 'THE GAME WORKS LIKE THIS.  WE SPIN THIS TOP. IF THE GREEN SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET DOUBLE YOUR MONEY BACK.  IF A BLUE SIDE COMES UP, YOU GET YOUR MONEY BACK.  IF A RED SIDE COMES UP, YOU LOSE.'
entries.text: 「規則是這樣：我們轉這個陀螺。轉到綠面，你們拿回兩倍的錢；轉到藍面，錢原數奉還；轉到紅面，你們就輸了。」

entries.source: 'THE GATE IS TOO STRONG TO BE TAKEN BY STORM. A SMALL BAND MUST SLIP INSIDE AND HOLD UNTIL RELIEVED. YOU ARE THE BEST AND THE BRAVEST. THE COUNCIL HAS INSTRUCTED ME TO ENTRUST THE TASK TO YOU.'
entries.text: 「那道門太堅固，硬攻是攻不下的。得有一小隊人潛進去撐到援軍抵達。你們是最強也最勇敢的一群，議會指示我把這件事託付給你們。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

'THESE ARE ALL OF THE COMMISSIONS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE.'

entries.source: 'WE ARE JUST OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. PROCLAMATIONS ARE POSTED ON THESE WALLS. INSIDE, THE CITY CLERK AWARDS THE COUNCIL'S COMMISSIONS.  COMMISSIONS ARE THE QUICKEST WAY TO FAME AND FORTUNE.'
entries.text: 「我們就在市政廳外面。公告都貼在這幾面牆上。裡頭的書記官負責發放市議會的委託。想快點成名發財，接委託是最快的路。」

entries.source: 'WHEN YOU GET TO ZHENTIAL KEEP, PRESENT THIS PACKET TO ITS COMMANDANT.  DO NOT BREAK THE SEALS OR YOU WILL BE SEIZED AS SPIES.'
entries.text: 「到了漢提爾城堡，把這包文件交給指揮官。千萬別拆封，否則會被當成間諜逮捕。」

entries.source: 'YOU NOW FACE AN ENTRANCE TO THE TEMPLE OF TYR.  THERE ARE THREE TEMPLES IN PHLAN: TYR'S, SUNE'S, AND TEMPUS. TYR'S IS THE LARGEST AND HOUSES BISHOP BRACCIO. IF YOU WILL TURN AROUND NOW, '
entries.text: 「你們面前是提爾神殿的入口。菲蘭城裡有三座神殿：提爾、蘇妮與坦帕斯。提爾神殿最大，巴西歐主教就住在裡面。現在請轉過身來，」

entries.source: 'YOU WILL SEE THE ENTRANCE TO THE PASSENGER DOCK AREA WE JUST DEPARTED.  FEW SHIPS DARE THE PERILOUS PASSAGE HERE, BUT THE COUNCIL IS DEVELOPING A PLAN TO OPEN UP THE SEA LANES.  PLEASE FOLLOW ME.'
entries.text: 「就會看到我們剛才離開的客運碼頭入口。敢走這條險路的船不多，不過市議會正在擬定計畫，要把航道打通。請跟我來。」
entries.note: Rolf 導覽第三頁，承接上一頁的句子。The City Council 依 glossary 作市議會。

entries.source: 'YOUR PARTY IS TOO LARGE TO JOIN AT THIS TIME.  RETURN WHEN IT IS SMALLER.'

entries.note: 劇情事件；Cadorna 依 glossary 作卡多納。

entries.source: THE CLERK SHUFFLES THROUGH HER PAPERS. 'ON THE MATTER OF COMMISSION,' SHE SAYS, 'I CAN OFFER THE FOLLOWING: '
entries.text: 書記官翻了翻手邊的文件：「關於委託，」她說，「我能提供以下幾項：」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL HAS AWARDED A BONUS FOR YOUR ELIMINATING NORRIS THE GRAY.
entries.text: 你們除掉了挪里斯，議會另發一筆獎金。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL HAS NOTED THE PASSING OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA.'
entries.text: 議會已知悉叛徒卡多納的死訊。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL HAS VOTED A SPECIAL PRIZE FOR ENDING THE GRAVEYARD MENACE.
entries.text: 你們解除了墳場之患，議會表決通過一筆特別獎賞。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL IS OFFERING A REWARD FOR BOOKS, MAPS, TOMES, ETC. WHICH PROVIDE USEFUL INFORMATION ABOUT PHLAN BEFORE THE FALL.  THE REWARD IS TIED TO THE VALUE OF THE INFORMATION.'
entries.text: 議會懸賞書籍、地圖、典籍等一切能提供菲蘭城陷落前資訊的東西，賞金視資訊價值而定。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL WAS PLEASED BY THE ELIMINATION OF THE THIEVES IN KOVEL MANSION.
entries.text: 你們肅清了柯威大樓裡的盜賊，議會相當滿意。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE COUNCIL WILL BE AMUSED BY THE DESCRIPTIONS.
entries.text: 議會看了這些記述會很有意思。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE DOOR IS LOCKED.  DO YOU WANT TO BREAK IN?
THE GUARD CAPTAIN STEPS FORWARD. 'PLEASE LET US SHOW YOU THE WAY.'
entries.text: 衛隊長走上前來：「請讓我們帶路。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE HARBOR MASTER TELLS YOU BOATS LEAVE FOR THE WEST, THE EAST, SOKAL KEEP, AND THE NORTH SIDE OF THE BAY.  'ROUND TRIP PASSAGE IS 1 PLATINUM PIECE. WHAT PASSAGE CAN I SELL YOU?'
entries.text: 港務長告訴你們，有船開往西邊、東邊、索卡爾城堡與海灣北岸。「來回船票一枚白金幣。要買哪一趟？」

entries.source: THE HEIR TO THE HOUSE OF BIVANT MUST BE RESCUED.  WE WILL PAY GENEROUSLY FOR HIS SAFE RETURN.'
entries.text: 畢凡特家的繼承人必須救回來。平安帶回，重金酬謝。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE MAD MAN SUDDENLY BEGINS TO SCREAM AND ATTACK EVERYONE WITHIN ARM'S REACH.
entries.text: 那個瘋子突然尖叫起來，見人就打。

entries.source: THE PRIESTS OF TEMPUS BID YOU WELCOME.
entries.text: 坦帕斯神殿的僧侶歡迎你們。

entries.source: THE PRIESTS OF TYR WELCOME YOU TO THE TEMPLE.
entries.text: 提爾神殿的僧侶歡迎你們入內。

entries.source: THE RECORDS PROVIDE INSIGHTS INTO MUCH THAT WAS PUZZLING.
entries.text: 這些記錄解開了不少一直想不通的事。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE REMAINING GUARDS DECIDE TO LEAVE YOU ALONE.
entries.text: 剩下的守衛決定不再找你們麻煩。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE SHOP SELLS SILVER ITEMS. 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEE OUR SELECTION?'
entries.text: 這家店賣銀器。「要看看我們的貨嗎？」

entries.source: THE SHOP SPECIALIZES IN ARMS AND ARMOR. 'CAN I SHOW YOU OUR WARES?'
entries.text: 這家店專賣武器與護甲。「要我拿貨給你們看嗎？」

entries.source: THE SHOPKEEPER GREETS YOU AND OFFERS YOU ITEMS FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?'
entries.text: 店主招呼你們，開始兜售商品。「要我拿些東西給你們看嗎？」

entries.source: THE SHOPKEEPER OFFERS JEWELRY FOR SALE. 'CAN I SHOW YOU SOMETHING?'
entries.text: 店主賣的是珠寶。「要我拿些東西給你們看嗎？」

entries.source: THE SLUMS IMMEDIATELY TO OUR WEST NEED TO BE CLEARED OF MONSTERS.'
entries.text: 我們西邊那片貧民區的怪物必須清掉。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THE TEMPLE GUARDS INFORM YOU THAT THE BISHOP IS NOT RECEIVING VISITORS AT THIS TIME.  WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 神殿衛兵告訴你們，主教這時候不見客。你們要怎麼做？

entries.source: THE UNDEAD ARE CROSSING THE RIVER IN HORDES AND KILLING OR CARRYING OFF OUR SETTLERS.  THE COUNCIL DEMANDS THESE ATTACKS BE STOPPED. A GENEROUS REWARD IS OFFERED.'
entries.text: 不死怪物成群渡河而來，殺害或擄走我們的移民。議會要求制止這些襲擊，並提供優厚報酬。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。
市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THESE HISTORIES CONTAIN MUCH USEFUL INFORMATION.
entries.text: 這些史料裡有很多有用的東西。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THESE MAPS SHOULD HELP US TO LOCATE SEVERAL LEGENDARY BUILDINGS.
entries.text: 這些地圖應該能幫我們找出幾座傳說中的建築。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。
怪物名。與職業 Thief（賊）分開用字，避免混淆。

entries.source: THIS LOSS OF THE KOBOLD FORCES WILL BE A MAJOR BLOW TO THE ENEMY.
entries.text: 小妖魔的兵力折損，對敵方是一大打擊。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: THIS MATERIAL IS OF SMALL VALUE.
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: TO THE NORTH IS THE PASSENGER DOCK.
UNDEAD FROM THE GRAVEYARD HAVE GROWN MORE DANGEROUS THAN ALL OF THE OTHER FORCES WHICH CONFRONT US.
entries.text: 墳場裡的不死怪物，如今比其他所有敵人都還危險。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.text: 這些論述對我們很有用。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: WE NEED YOU TO DELIVER A MESSAGE TO THE ZHENTIL KEEP TO THE WEST. BE CAREFUL, THE TRAITOR CADORNA MAY HAVE TAMPERED WITH THE MESSAGE PACKET BEFORE HE FLED.'
entries.text: 我們需要你們把一封信送到西邊的漢提爾城堡。小心，叛徒卡多納逃走前可能動過那包文件。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: WE WERE MUCH RELIEVED BY THE NEWS YOU BRING FROM THE NOMAD CAMP.
entries.text: 你們從遊牧民營地帶回的消息讓我們鬆了一口氣。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: WE WERE PLEASANTLY SURPRISED THAT YOU COMPLETED YOUR MISSION SO SWIFTLY.  CADORNA WAS WAGERING YOUR RETURN WOULD BE MUCH DELAYED.
entries.text: 你們這麼快就辦完了，令我們喜出望外。卡多納還打賭你們會拖上許久才回來。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。
隊伍強度回報，見 spec 030 的 PARTYSTRENGTH。

entries.source: WITH SOKAL KEEP IN OUR HANDS, WE CAN USE BOATS TO BYPASS THE BARREN RIVER.
entries.text: 索卡爾城堡到手之後，我們就能走船繞過那條荒蕪之河。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: WITH THE CLEARING OF THE STOJONOW RIVER, WE CAN OPEN UP THE HINTERLANDS FOR TRADE.
entries.text: 史塔傑諾河清乾淨了，內陸的商路就能打通。
entries.note: 原版此處把 STOJANOW 拼成 STOJONOW。

entries.source: YOU ARE BY THE GATEWAY TO THE UNSETTLED AREAS. THE CITY WATCH EYES YOU SUSPICIOUSLY.
entries.text: 你們就在通往未開發地區的門邊。城衛隊用懷疑的眼神打量你們。

entries.source: YOU ARE IN A TAVERN.  THE AIR IS FILLED WITH SMOKE AND GOSSIP.  PEOPLE ARE GAMBLING AT THE TABLES.
entries.text: 你們在一間酒館裡，空氣中滿是煙味與閒話，桌邊有人在賭錢。

entries.source: YOU ARE INTERCEPTED BY THE COUNCIL GUARD. 'HALT.  YOUR PRESENCE IS NOT AUTHORIZED.  LEAVE.'  DO YOU LEAVE?
entries.text: 議會衛兵攔下你們：「站住。你們沒有獲准進入，離開。」你們要離開嗎？
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE OUTSIDE THE CITY HALL. THE CITY CLERK WAITS INSIDE TO AWARD COMMISSIONS.
entries.text: 你們站在市政廳外。書記官在裡面發放委託。

entries.source: YOU ARE OUTSIDE THE CLERK'S OFFICE. GUARDS POSTED AROUND A DOOR IN THE SOUTH WALL WATCH YOU CLOSELY.
entries.text: 你們在書記官辦公室外。南牆那道門邊站著衛兵，緊盯著你們。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE ROUSTED BY THE CITY WATCH AND TOLD TO MOVE ALONG. WHAT DO YOU DO?
entries.text: 城衛隊把你們趕起來，要你們別逗留。你們要怎麼做？

entries.source: YOU ARE SUMMONED BY THE BISHOP OF BRACCIO OF TYR. REPORT TO HIM AT TYR'S TEMPLE.'
entries.text: 提爾神殿的巴西歐主教召見你們，到提爾神殿去見他。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE SUMMONED TO A SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING.  YOU ARE TO BE AWARDED A VALUABLE COMMISSION. THE CITY GUARDS WILL SHOW YOU THE WAY.'
entries.text: 議會召開特別會議，要授予你們一件重要的委託。城衛隊會帶路。」
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE BISHOP'S STUDY. BISHOP BRACCIO SPEAKS, 'ALLOW ME TO INTRODUCE DIRTEN, PRIEST OF ILMAR.
entries.text: 你們被帶進主教的書房。巴西歐主教說：「讓我介紹伊爾瑪的僧侶迪爾騰。
entries.note: 提爾神殿；句子在原版就沒有收尾，接下一段。

entries.source: YOU ARE USHERED INTO THE STUDY WHERE DIRTEN WAITS.  'I AM ABOUT TO JOURNEY TO THE TEMPLE, WILL YOU COME WITH ME?'
entries.text: 你們被帶進書房，迪爾騰在裡面等著。「我正要動身去那座神殿，你們願意同行嗎？」

entries.source: YOU ARE WELCOMED BY PRIESTESS JOY OF SUNE.
entries.text: 蘇妮神殿的喬伊女祭司歡迎你們。

entries.source: YOU ATTACKED THE CITY WATCH, YOU WON'T BEAT US SO EASILY!
entries.text: 你們攻擊了城衛隊，沒那麼容易打贏我們！

entries.source: YOU ENTER THE CITY HALL.  AS YOU FACE DOWN THE HALLWAY, YOU SEE A GUARDED DOOR.
entries.text: 你們走進市政廳。順著走廊看去，有一道門守著衛兵。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOU FEEL A LIGHT TOUCH ON YOUR PURSE.  DO YOU IGNORE IT OR GRAB THE OFFENDING HAND?
entries.text: 你們感覺錢袋被輕輕碰了一下。要不理會，還是抓住那隻手？

entries.source: YOU HAVE CLEARED THE AREA NEXT TO THE EVIL TEMPLE.
entries.text: 你們清空了邪惡神廟旁的區域。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.text: 你們聽到酒館裡的傳言

entries.source: YOU REALIZE YOU HAVE BEEN VICTIMIZED BY A PICKPOCKET.

entries.note: 遭遇敘述的開頭片段，後面接怪物名。

entries.source: YOUR CLEARING OF THE SLUM AREAS PERMITS US TO EXPAND.
entries.text: 你們清空了貧民區，我們才得以往外拓展。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOUR ELIMINATION OF THE LIZARDMEN MENACE HAS GREATLY IMPROVED OUR STRATEGIC POSITION.
entries.text: 你們解除了蜥蜴人的威脅，我方的戰略處境大為改善。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOUR SUCCESS AT PODAL PLAZA IS NOTED.
entries.text: 你們在波多廣場的表現已記錄在案。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。

entries.source: YOUR TAKING THE GATE WILL ENABLE OUR FORCES TO ASSAULT THE ENEMY STRONGHOLD. RETURN THERE TO LEAD THE ATTACK.
entries.text: 你們拿下那道門，我軍才能進攻敵方要塞。回去領頭發動攻擊。
entries.note: 市政廳書記官的委託與回報。專名依 glossary。
